glosses: The currency of Greece in ancient times and again from 1832 until 2001, with the symbol ₯, since replaced by the euro.

examples.text: 'Who is he, and where does he come from?' said I, 'and what does he charge?' 'Evenus of Paros, Socrates,' said he, 'and his fee is 500 drachmae.' I felt that Evenus was to be congratulated if he really was a master of this art and taught it at such a moderate fee.
2008, Philip Matyszak, Ancient Athens on Five Drachmas a Day (title of the book)

examples.text: L’obole de deux drachmes que les Juifs de la diaspora avaient à cœur d’envoyer chaque année à Jérusalem pour l’entretien du Temple, il a été décidé qu'ils la paieraient toujours mais qu’elle serait désormais affectée à l’entretien du Capitole, c'est-à-dire au culte des dieux païens.
